name: AdaptlyPost
description: Handles drafting, queuing and publishing across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky without leaving one conversation. The case for it is breadth, so anyone posting to a single network is unlikely to notice the benefit; account connections are a prerequisite.
